answer: Agents bond stake, register a Semaphore commitment, and evaluate an epoch-bound polynomial whose shares authorize rate-limited proofs. The shale ledger checks each proof’s nullifier; a repeated message in the same epoch exposes two distinct shares, allowing Shamir interpolation to recover the agent’s private identity key. The inlet verifier submits that evidence to the ledge contract, which invalidates the identity and immediately slashes its collateral.
